summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the locally-shipped `math_init.js` — a ~728KB heavily obfuscated `@bun-cjs` bundle featuring string-array shuffling (WV8StW), a mixed numeric/string constant array (n7gIxM), and character-decoding lookups (hc1jfK9). Running an obfuscated bundle under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime at install time delivers arbitrary code execution on the installer while evading Node-based static analysis. The package.json `name` is `@hubsync/web-sdk-react` but the `description` and README identify the artifact as the Verdocs Web SDK for React, and the shipped dist/ references api.verdocs.com, beta.verdocs.com, and stage.verdocs.com — a scope-mismatched impersonation of the Verdocs SDK.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
